_note: Things every Exotic cockpit root carries. CockpitRoot_DoNotRename is cloned at install time from the live Piercer cockpit named in rootDonorCockpitId, so size (7.5 x 1.2 x 10.5), material, physical properties and the TemplateRole attribute match. Its children are then moved or rebuilt as listed here. Positions are root local (+X right, +Y up, forward -Z).
_rootDonorChildren: The exact child list of the donor root, verified live 2026-10-02. The audit stops if the live donor differs. The two lens names end in a space, as on the live Piercer.
_hoverDust: Piercer keeps them at (+-3, -1.375, +-6.092). Exotic: under the front and rear arch centres (Z -7.4 and 6.8), same height.

underglow._removeLightsUnderMount: The donor (bruiser_03) has a SurfaceLight parented straight to the mount Attachment. A SurfaceLight needs a part face, so the Exotic uses the documented form instead: emitter Parts under UNDERGLOW_EMITTERS_DoNotRename (as COCKPIT_BRUISER_02).
underglow._emitters: One invisible slab just under the tub floor (bottom face at Y -0.45). Light values copied from the main emitter of COCKPIT_BRUISER_02. Enabled=false in the template; VehicleCosmeticCatalog.ApplyPresentation sets Enabled and Color from the saved cosmetic state.

_lenses: The two invisible light-source parts cloned with the donor root (SpotLight off, SurfaceLight on, Shadows off). Rotation and light properties stay as the donor has them; only the position moves, to inside the nose and the tail wall. Remove an entry to delete that lens instead.
